# India eVisa

> > Official guide to Indian eVisa applications including e-Tourist, Business, and Medical visas for international travelers visiting India.

India eVisa provides comprehensive information on electronic visa applications for travelers from over 160 countries. The site covers visa eligibility, application procedures, travel authorization requirements, and destination guides for popular locations including Goa, Kerala, Rajasthan, Mumbai, and Jaipur.
